sources.text: Pump P1 is a pump and has the port out and the port in. Reactor R1 is a reactor and has the port in, the port out, and the port signal in. Collector C1 is a collector and has the port in. Sensor S1 is a sensor and has the port signal out.

A material connection runs from Pump P1 out to Reactor R1 in. A material connection runs from Reactor R1 out to Collector C1 in. An information connection runs from Sensor S1 signal out to Reactor R1 signal in.
Step 1 is Load. Step 2 is React. Step 3 is Collect. Step 1 precedes Step 2. Step 2 precedes Step 3.
